title: PIN reminder
summary: A spaced "Lembra sua senha?" check so the person does not forget the PIN that brings the account back (bipe-chat/bipe#202, ADR 0057). A card at the top of Conversas opens the PIN field.

due.description: The reminder time of this account has come (pinReminder schedule) and the prompt slot allows prompt pinReminder.

pin.description: The digits typed, pinLength at most. Memory only, never logged.

phase.description: checking: POST /v1/me/pin/check runs. right: bipe_pin_reminder_right. wrong: bipe_pin_reminder_wrong and the change PIN action. failed: no network.

open.effect: Opens the PIN field from the card.

submit.effect: At pinLength digits: POST /v1/me/pin/check. 204: phase right; the schedule goes one step on (pinReminderNext right). 403 pin_wrong: phase wrong; the schedule goes back to step 0. 403 pin_blocked: shows bipe_pin_blocked_body. One check per reminder: after wrong the field closes.

changePin.effect: From wrong: opens pin-change (biometric check first).

later.effect: Agora não: keeps the step and asks again after 1 day (pinReminderNext later).

notes: A wrong PIN counts against the account like on the recovery paths (POST /v1/me/pin/check in api/openapi.yaml); a right PIN sets the count to 0. So the reminder allows one check, then offers to change the PIN.

The gaps come from the generated onboarding code (BipeOnboarding.pinReminderDays, pinReminderThenEveryDays). The first reminder comes pinReminderDays[0] after this phone first saw the account. The step and the next time are kept per account on this phone. Rule: pinReminderNext, test-vectors/onboarding-schedule.json.
bipe_pin_reminder_body takes pinLength. bipe_pin_blocked_body takes pinMaxWrongTries and names only the recovery email, the one PIN reset path that is built.
